title: Minimum Platform Allocation
description: Given arrival and departure times for trains at a station, determine the minimum number of platforms required so that no train waits for a free platform.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000; 0 <= arrival, departure <= 10^9; every departure is after its corresponding arrival.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n arrival times. Third line: n departure times.
outputFormat: Print the minimum number of platforms required.
hints: Sort arrivals and departures separately and track how many trains are currently present.

examples.explanation: At the busiest moment, three trains require platforms simultaneously.
The trains do not overlap, so one platform is sufficient.
